# Smart Contract

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SmartContract`](gmeow-SmartContract.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SmartContract>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A deployed program on a blockchain or distributed ledger, identified by a contract address.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SmartContract`](gmeow-SmartContract.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model a deployed on-chain program — a registry, oracle, or attestation contract — identified by its address, when it is the source or anchor of ledger-based attestation evidence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an address-controlled wallet that signs transactions (that is [`gmeow:BlockchainAccount`](gmeow-BlockchainAccount.md)) and for the network it runs on ([`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md)); the contract is the deployed code, not an account or a chain.

### How to use

- Mint the contract with [`gmeow:contractAddress`](../properties/gmeow-contractAddress.md) (the EL minimum), locate it on its [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md), and link emitted [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](gmeow-LedgerEvent.md) records back to it.

### Examples

- ex:registry a [`gmeow:SmartContract`](gmeow-SmartContract.md); [`gmeow:contractAddress`](../properties/gmeow-contractAddress.md) "0x1234...".
